function <toplevel>() stack=1
	maketuple 0
	makefunc 0 (outer)
	setglobal 0 (outer)
	none
	return

function outer(a) stack=2
	cells: a, b
	int 0 (1)
	setlocalcell 1 (b)
	local 0 (a)
	local 1 (b)	@1:1
	maketuple 2
	makefunc 0 (middle)
	setlocal 2 (middle)
	localcell 1 (b)	@9:27
	local 0 (a)
	maketuple 2
	makefunc 1 (lambda)
	setlocal 3 (adder)
	local 2 (middle)	@10:12
	local 3 (adder)	@10:20
	maketuple 2
	return

function middle() stack=2
	freevars: a, b
	free 0 (a)
	free 1 (b)
	maketuple 2
	makefunc 0 (inner)
	setlocal 0 (inner)
	local 0 (inner)	@7:16
	return

function inner() stack=2
	freevars: a, b
	freecell 0 (a)	@6:20
	freecell 1 (b)	@6:24
	plus	@6:22
	return

function lambda(x, y) stack=2
	freevars: a
	local 0 (x)
	local 1 (y)
	plus	@9:32
	freecell 0 (a)	@9:38
	plus	@9:36
	return
